name: @tiledev/sdk-analytics-core
description: Dependency-free analytics contract for TilePacket apps: the AnalyticsAdapter interface every provider implements, the DefaultEvents catalogue, the device/event wire types, and the builders for what each event carries (the Apptile engine's payloads, from Shopify objects). Imported by @tiledev/sdk-analytics-* and the app's analytics provider.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('dist/index.js')){console.error('
  REFUSING TO PUBLISH: dist/index.js is missing. Run: npm run build
  (build is clean+tsc; if tsc is not installed the clean still runs and empties dist)
');process.exit(1)}"
